statement: A worker holding an expired lease must not be able to commit a result after ownership transfers; a monotonic fence token carried on every write is what makes stale-writer rejection decidable.
basis: Long-established practice in lease-based distributed systems: leases alone are insufficient under arbitrary pauses, so writes must carry a monotonically increasing token that the sink checks.
external_literature_citation_reason: No web search or documentation-browsing tool is available in this session, so no source can be fetched, read and hashed. Recording a citation from memory would be indistinguishable from fabrication.
predicted_observation: A result document whose fence_token is absent or below 1 is rejected by the executable validator.
falsifier: A document with fence_token 0 validates successfully.
reproduction_scope: Document-contract level only. The invariant is enforced on recorded results, not by a live sink rejecting a stale writer mid-flight.

statement: Retries are only safe when each attempt carries a stable idempotency key, so that a duplicate delivery is recognisable rather than producing a second effect.
basis: Standard at-least-once delivery practice: the receiver deduplicates on a caller-supplied key because the transport cannot promise exactly-once.
external_literature_citation_reason: No search or browse tool available this session.
predicted_observation: A result with an empty idempotency key is rejected, and no two counted units in the registry share a key.
falsifier: An empty idempotency key validates, or two registry rows share a key.
reproduction_scope: Presence and uniqueness are enforced. Runtime deduplication of a real duplicate callback was not exercised, because no callback transport existed this session.

statement: An append-only event log with contiguous sequence numbers lets a restarted coordinator reconstruct what happened and detect gaps, which a mutable summary record cannot do.
basis: Established event-sourcing and write-ahead-log practice: ordering plus gap detection is what makes replay sound.
external_literature_citation_reason: No search or browse tool available this session.
predicted_observation: The committed event files carry unique ids and sequence numbers 1..N with no gap, so a missing event is detectable.
falsifier: A gap or duplicate sequence number passes the gate.
reproduction_scope: The log is append-only by convention and enforced only for contiguity and uniqueness. Nothing physically prevents a rewrite of a committed event file other than git history.

basis: Established interface-versioning practice: permissive readers accumulate silent divergence between the declared contract and the enforced one.

statement: Separating producer from acceptor prevents self-certification; if the same identity can both produce and accept, recorded acceptance carries no information.
basis: Established separation-of-duties practice in assurance and change control.
external_literature_citation_reason: No search or browse tool available this session.
predicted_observation: A result whose reviewer_id equals its worker_id is rejected, and no document committed by this Wave records ACCEPTED for its own acceptance.

reproduction_scope: Enforced both per-document and repository-wide. This Wave also demonstrates the cost of the rule: because no independent reviewer could be dispatched, every unit stays NOT_TESTED rather than being self-accepted.

statement: A content-addressed manifest detects silent drift that a file listing cannot, but only if it describes exactly the bytes it claims to cover; following a symlink out of the covered subtree makes the coverage claim false.
basis: Established integrity-manifest practice: the manifest must be computed over the same closure it asserts.

basis: Established build-provenance practice: verify the artifact in the immutable store that consumers will read.
